strings.name: Charlize Theron
strings.summary: Raised in South Africa, Theron moved from dance and modeling into acting. Monster earned her an Oscar; action roles and producing expanded her portrayals of women. She founded an African youth health and education initiative. In 2026 she starred in Apex, combining physical performance and character work.
